mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_quartz_task_log( task_id, task_name, task_params, process_status, process_duration, process_log, ip_address, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{entity.taskId}, #{entity.taskName}, #{entity.taskParams}, #{entity.processStatus}, #{entity.processDuration}, #{entity.processLog}, #{entity.ipAddress}, #{entity.createTime}, #{entity.updateTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_quartz_task_log SET process_log = CONCAT(IFNULL(process_log, ''), #{line}, '\n'), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_quartz_task_log SET process_status = #{processStatus}, process_duration = #{processDuration}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
